native_context: Mail-domain authorization and DMARC identifier alignment
taxonomy_note: Planning lens only; actual root-cause mapping is independent.

controls.boundary: Mail-domain authorization and DMARC identifier alignment — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Collect exact author/envelope/signing domains, timestamped DNS and sanitized authentication results from a trusted receiver. Record receiver/version policy and legitimate senders.
controls.controlled_verification: From supplied mail or an owned local receiver, evaluate SPF/DKIM authentication separately from DMARC identifier alignment. Compare a legitimate aligned sender with an unaligned identity fixture and determine which receiver result is authoritative; a sender-supplied Authentication-Results header is not trusted evidence.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Missing records, monitoring policy or SPF pass for an unaligned envelope domain do not demonstrate an accepted aligned forgery. Display-name similarity and forwarding have different prerequisites.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Correct the evidenced sender/alignment/policy with staged owner validation of legitimate mail. Retest approved senders and the controlled invalid identity under the relevant receiver contract.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
